newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic to market multi-purpose catheter.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic to market multi-purpose catheter.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Monday it received clearance by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its Millenia balloon catheter, a multi-purpose catheter used for a variety of functions in opening blood pathways on the surface of the heart.
Medtronic said the catheter also offers important cost savings because it can reduce the number of catheters needed during each procedure.
The Millenia is offered in nine balloon diameters and is currently available in non-U.S. markets.

Michael Baker, vice president and general manager of Medtronic Interventional Vascular, said "The new Millenia product expands the capabilities of balloon catheters while reducing the cost of care. We believe it is the ideal choice for complex cases and we expect it to quickly win medical acceptance in the United States."
Medtronic develops and markets implantable and invasive therapies.
Shares of Medtronic were trading up 3/4 to 65-1/4.
